note: Eight-field closure chains for every consequential flow the concepts exercise. UI-local expansion (long messages, group collapse, tab selection) remains local view state per 08's escape valve and is deliberately absent here.

chains.validation: Permissions + route availability; offline diverts to outbox
chains.durable_state: thread.messages append; draft cleared; revision retained
chains.projection: thread-concept arrival board; scroll follow if at bottom
chains.recovery: Stop preserves partial; offline queues exactly-once

chains.durable_state: redirect message + original attempt + interruption state retained
chains.projection: work surface rewrites summary in place; redirect flag on message
chains.recovery: resumed/replacement attempt tracked on the turn

chains.validation: geometry controller may degrade full→compact (floor rule)

chains.owner: Artifact service (Project-backed); Chat holds selection only

chains.validation: submit gate: required unanswered && unskipped block
chains.durable_state: answers, explicit skips, freeform, index, status persisted
chains.projection: eight per-concept compositions; composer lockout while active
chains.recovery: skip reversible before submit; cancel leaves historical record; queue promotes next

chains.validation: state-conditional control enablement (disabled with reason otherwise)
chains.projection: scene block / manifest / postings / case file / prose / weight / status line / troupe
chains.recovery: blocked exposes cause/scope/attempted/why/next-safe; recover restores running

chains.validation: none destructive — canonical history + ancestry preserved
chains.event_receipt: compact receipt with before/after tokens + rehydration note

chains.validation: Apply caps at 25 per operation, accumulates
chains.recovery: Turn Off per message; human search unaffected (canonical history)

chains.validation: availability; unavailable → Provider Settings deep-link with return context
chains.durable_state: thread-local route; requested vs effective with reason
chains.recovery: requested route retained for truthful display

chains.validation: predicted material change only (never every route change)
chains.durable_state: Continue → requested/effective recorded; Branch/Start → new leaf threads

chains.validation: scope shown; persistence stated (this run only)

chains.recovery: reconnect replays exactly once (replayLog); second replay no-ops
buffered events apply after snapshot point

chains.validation: bounded task, scope, budget, idempotency, cycle protection
chains.recovery: await resumes inactive target then returns it to rest

chains.validation: source immutable; files never rolled back
chains.durable_state: new leaf with parent pointer; restore points immutable
chains.projection: branch flag on thread title; history rows
chains.recovery: re-answer as sibling via branch at questionnaire message

chains.durable_state: draft attachments with class + lineage note
chains.projection: composer chip row; alternate class raises consent warning
chains.recovery: remove per chip; unsupported clearly labeled with reason
explicit clear only; crash restore proven by reload probe
